Our Mission: Driving solutions that ensure the success of our customers, employees, and communities.
PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
AGRONOMY
We provide the expertise, knowledge, equipment, and facilities to maximize your yields. We look to be a trusted partner you can count on, whatever your need – seed, fertilizer, crop protection products, and custom application services. Our Decision Ag team of precision ag specialists helps you utilize data and technology to take your farming operation to the next level.
Read More >
GRAIN
River Valley Cooperative grain is your local partner in your operation. We are committed to making grain marketing and delivery as easy and efficient as possible. We have flexibility in how we work with grain customers. From timely, accurate payments to a variety of contracting options, we’ll help you do business the way you want to, when you want to.
Read More >
FEED
We supply quality bulk feed for swine and poultry throughout eastern Iowa and western Illinois. Our customers rely on us day in and day out, and we’re committed to doing things right. Once you begin doing business with us, we offer an automated ordering system to conveniently place orders and keep track of previous purchases.
Read More >
ENERGY
Let our energy professionals shoulder the responsibility when it comes to your needs for propane, refined fuels and quality oils and lubricants. Our monitored service keeps your propane tank full, so you never need to check the level or worry about running out. Our full-time account managers are ready and available to talk and get you set up on a plan that suits your farm, home or business.
Read More >
RVC EDGE
Whether you need savings on inputs or access to exclusive offers, we’re here to support your operation and keep you growing strong. Earn reward points on your RVC purchases that add up to dollars off your next purchase with us. Move through the tiers to gain greater benefits at each level.
Read More >
YIELDVANCE
We are dedicated to building a distinctive brand for our cooperative owners, offering agronomy products that stand out in the market. Our focus is on delivering competitive solutions tailored to the unique needs of our customers and territory, setting us apart from the competition. Our full-time account managers are ready and available to talk and get you set up on a plan that suits your farm, home or business.
Read More >
CONNECTED TO OUR COMMUNITIES
River Valley Cooperative believes in giving back to the communities where our facilities are located and where our employees live, work and play. Throughout the year, donations are presented to many essential local organizations and events, including area food banks, community projects, 4-H and FFA youth activities.
